name: PARADIGM HOMES CHARITABLE HOUSING ASSOCIATION LIMITED

announcements.headline: Lifestone appoints New Chief Executive Officer
announcements.insight: Lifestone appoints a new CEO following Matthew Bailes' departure in June. This leadership change follows the name change and accounts delay.

announcements.headline: Change of Name
announcements.insight: Paradigm Homes Charitable Housing Association Limited has changed its name. This follows the CEO departure in June and accounts delay in September.

announcements.headline: Publication delay of audited accounts to 30/09/26
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a delay in the publication of audited accounts, which is typically an administrative update regarding reporting timelines rather than a substantive operational event. For shareholders, this signifies a postponement of financial transparency without implying immediate changes to the company's strategic direction or financial health.

announcements.headline: Matthew Bailes to step down as Chief Executive
announcements.insight: The Chief Executive is stepping down. This departure of senior leadership may influence future strategic direction and governance stability for shareholders.
